valid_fixes: Restore ApiHandlerFunction env DB_PORT to !GetAtt OrdersDb.Endpoint.Port so the Lambda connects to the real RDS port
invalid_patches: Change RDS port to 5433 to match the wrong env var
Remove VpcConfig from Lambda to bypass networking
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_get_environment_variables(ace-bench-stack-api-handler) → shows DB_PORT=5433 vs real RDS port
ace_describe_db_instance(ace-bench-stack-orders-db) → shows Endpoint.Port=5432; mismatch with DB_PORT env var confirms root cause
observability_check: functional_test assertion 'order_created' (POST /orders returns 201) fails; Lambda logs show connection refused or timeout on port 5433
observable_symptom: POST /orders returns 502 or 500 on every request. Lambda logs show a database connection error — the handler attempts to connect on a port where no PostgreSQL server is listening. The RDS instance itself is healthy and its actual endpoint is reachable on the correct port.
root_cause: The Lambda function's DB_PORT environment variable is hardcoded to 5433 instead of being resolved dynamically from the RDS endpoint. PostgreSQL listens on port 5432. Every invocation fails immediately with a connection refused error before any query is attempted.
